title: DarkSleep
description: RPG Theme, Changes the sleep percentage required of a server to 50% allowing only half the players to sleep to progress the night.
body:
# DarkSleep **DESCRIPTION** A simple player sleep percentage changing mod _Server side is supported. You can install this on the server and not need to have it installed on the client._ Created by the same authors who made [DarkRPG](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/darkrpg) (for a full RPG experience, get the [DarkRPG modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/darkrpg) and enjoy quests and rpg gameplay)   ## Features (Your vanilla experience will be further enhanced thanks to these features)  In a vanilla game on servers, by default it requires everyone on the server to sleep in order to progress the night. This can be annoying for players especially if you have AFK players.  With DarkSleep this changes it from 100% to 50% player sleep percentage. This means only half the server player base is required to sleep in order to progress the night. Example: if you have 20 players on your server, only 10 will be required to sleep for the night to progress into day time.   Get a server today and play with your friends!
